threshold_sources.bars: E184's (predictions.json thresholds.bars); the cell's done-when names the same three
threshold_sources.r1_bar: E184's r1_bar: the filed comparisons read list all at bar 0.9
threshold_sources.cap: E184's cap of 16 names at rungs 1 and 2; every oracle form keeps W x (1 + R) <= 16
threshold_sources.exact_tol: an exact hand-written edit must close at least 1 - exact_tol. E184's searches closed its two built controls to 1 - 4e-9 (l1_neuron) and 1 - 7e-9 (l2_triggered) on the same write path; 1e-3 is five orders above that float floor and two below the smallest miss that would matter (0.05). The rank-one path's own floor is read in stage 1 (o3.start of the three exact items) and reported
threshold_sources.kl_rel_tol: the rebuilt F on E184's seeded windows must repeat E184's KL(F || M) within this relative difference: same code, seeds and windows, so only the card's float order differs (E184 ran on H100 pods)
threshold_sources.kl_floor: E184's kl_floor; the do-nothing read KL 0 exactly there

measures.o3: closure of the built edit as one rank-one edit h_in2 += rms_in2 d (a . (h_in1 - mu_in1) / rms_in1 + c), written by hand (o3.start); for the fine-tunes the teacher's form, refitted 400 Adam steps (o3.fitted). Rung 3, n 0
measures.forms: closure of the built edit rewritten on M's list with at most 16 names, numbers fitted by L-BFGS (50 iterations) from a least-squares start (each write's component of the push times L regressed on the reads): writes the W in2 principal directions most along the push ('pcs') or the W logits whose mean probability F moves most ('out'); reads the R list variables before in2, or tokens at the last two positions, most correlated with L; (W, R) in (16, 0), (4, 3), (2, 7), (1, 15); R = 0 is rung 1, R > 0 rung 2
measures.at_filed: the largest closure of an oracle at or below the item's filed rung: the forms of rung <= filed, and o3 when the filed rung is 3
measures.labels: per bar: e184_rung (E184's reading, list all); cause = null if e184_rung <= filed, 'search' if at_filed >= bar, 'class' if only o3 >= bar, else 'oracle short'; rung3_search_miss = e184_rung 4 and o3 >= bar
measures.ranking: for the best form at the filed rung, at E184's first greedy step (empty intervention, E184's sizes and seed): each write's shift score g^2/h, its rank among the list's writes, the 4th candidate's score (E184's line-search cut), the Newton step and the oracle's fitted shift
measures.share: share of the push's squared norm in in2's top-64 principal span, and of the read direction's in in1's
measures.repaired: stage 2: E184's search on list all, rungs 1-3, with K 16 (E184 4), line-search multiples 0.25-16 (E184 0.25-2), rung-3 screening 60 and full fits 400 Adam steps (E184 30, 80); readings as E184's rank_read.reading

stage1_stop.rule: controls first and alone, in order: any miss exits 1 and nothing further runs. Then per item, planted constant first: an exact item whose o3.start is under 1 - exact_tol, or any item whose KL misses E184's by more than kl_rel_tol, exits 1
stage1_stop.l1_neuron: the one-neuron edit written as Write(mlp2#36, shift s / sd): closure >= 1 - exact_tol (expected 1 - 1e-8)
stage1_stop.l2_triggered: Write(mlp2#1384, reads [in1.pc0]) with E184's s re-standardised: closure >= 1 - exact_tol (expected 1 - 1e-8)
stage1_stop.exact_items: planted_constant, planted_trigger, cue: o3.start >= 1 - exact_tol (expected 1 - 1e-6 or closer)

stage2_stop.rule: stage 2 runs only if some item has cause 'search' or rung3_search_miss at some bar. The repaired search first reads l1_neuron, l2_triggered, l4_bit on list all; any reading (rung, n, names) at any bar that differs from E184's exits 1 and no item is searched
stage2_stop.expected: l1_neuron rung 1, n 1, mlp2#36; l2_triggered rung 2, n 2, mlp2#1384 and in1.pc0->mlp2#1384; l4_bit rung 4 at every bar (E184's best 0.48)

expected._rule: descriptive: what the plan expects each number to read; 'as expected' or not is reported beside each
expected.share: push_in2 0.12 for every item (the push is Q b; measured on the dev node's CPU from E184's pcs.pt and E137's pieces.pt); read_in1 0.004 for the cue (its w), unknown for the parity and fact class directions

planted_constant.at_filed: < 0.8 (rung 1: E184's 16 names closed 0.72; the pcs writes hold 0.09 of the push in their top 16)

cue.at_filed: < 0.8 (w has 0.004 of its norm in in1's span)

expected.repaired: planted_trigger rung 3 at 0.95 and cue rung 3 at 0.9 and 0.95 (the rank-one search recovered with 5x the steps); no item recovered at its filed rung

R1.measure: summary.json R1, from labels['0.9'].cause of the seven items
R1.rival_a: some item's cause is 'search': an oracle with at most 16 of M's names at its filed rung closes at least 0.9 where E184's search read higher
R1.rival_b: no item's cause is 'search' (each is 'class', 'oracle short' or no miss), with every exact form closing at least 1 - exact_tol (else the job has stopped and R1 is 'not read')
R1.note: total: a and b are complements once stage 1 passes. Rival b is a reading of the oracles written here: a better hand-written oracle could still exist, so 'class' reads 'no evidence the filed rung is reachable', not a proof that it is not

R2.claim: descriptive: for each item and bar with cause 'search', whether the repaired search reads at or below the filed rung (recovered); for each rung3_search_miss, whether it reads rung 3 or below (rung3_recovered)

edge_cases.constant_label: planted_constant's L is 1 on every window (sd 0): no reads are ranked, only the (16, 0) forms run (rung 1)
edge_cases.fewer_reads: fewer valid reads than R (tokens under min_tok windows, sd 0): the form keeps those it has; its rung is 2 only if any read is kept
edge_cases.closure_at_bar: a closure exactly at a bar passes (rank_read.EPS)
edge_cases.nan_closure: passes no bar (x >= bar is False); a NaN fit is reverted by the refits, which keep a fit only if the check KL does not rise
edge_cases.ties: reads and writes of equal score: topk's order; the best form on equal closure: the first in (pcs, out) x splits order
edge_cases.zero_gap: no item has KL(F || M) under the floor (E184's smallest is the cue's 0.040); the do-nothing is read only against the floor, no closure divided
edge_cases.no_miss: an item whose E184 rung is at or below its filed rung gets cause null and is not searched in stage 2
edge_cases.fact_rung3: the fact is filed at rung 3, so its at_filed includes o3 and its cause is 'search' or 'oracle short', never 'class'
edge_cases.stage2_empty: no item needing repair: stage 2 is skipped (the controls are not re-searched) and R2 is empty

blind_to: oracles not written here (a cleverer hand choice of names could close where these do not); nonlinear variables; positions other than the last; anything off each item's windows
positive_control: stage 1: l1_neuron and l2_triggered written by hand close 1 (their E184 search readings); the three exact items' rank-one forms close 1. Stage 2: l1, l2 read as in E184 and l4_bit (random bit) stays at rung 4
noise_floor: closure: E184's twin seeds differ by 0.002 at one free edit (0.895, 0.897); float floor of the write path 1e-8
